name: year badge with cycling category chips and a proof stamp
looks: A bold founding year sits on a flat card with a small tag chip beneath it; the chip cycles through two more category tags, one per beat, building a short row of pills. It cuts to a claim about proof, and a stamp-like circle clamps down around a bold word declaring the work is proven, real and delivered.
build: The command-chip-cycle mechanic: a glowing DOM pill cycles through names on the beat, each one staying on screen as the next appears, building a row rather than replacing it. The proof stamp is a DOM/SVG ring scaling down onto the word with a slight overshoot (back.out).
sound: A blip per chip added, a riser into the final brighten, a solid thunk as the stamp clamps down.
prompt: Hold a bold founding year with a small tag chip beneath it, then add two more chips one at a time on the beat, building a short row naming the different kinds of work made, before cutting to a word declaring the work is proven, with a ring stamping down around it like a seal.
